explication: BookStack is a documentation platform for organizing books, chapters, and pages. A typical workflow is: a user authenticates, requests a page, the page controller loads and renders entity content, and the browser receives the result. Content management is governed by permissions and can include comments, activity tracking, uploads, search, exports, API access, and theming. The graph preserves these major capabilities; several subsystem relationships are inferred only from the tree because their implementations were not sampled.
